The importance of this errata list is discussed below. S. was still sensitive about the printing of
PU almost a year later, when he wrote to Ollier on 8 June 1821 explaining why he had decided
to take exceptional pains with the printing of Adonais: ‘My poem [Adonais] is finished . . .
 I shall send it to you, either printed at Pisa, or transcribed in such a manner, as it shall be dif-
ficult for the reviser to leave such errors as assist the obscurity of the “Prometheus” ’ (L ii 257;
see headnote to Adonais). After 1820, no further edition of PU was published in S.’s lifetime.
